published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned Scaffold-Effects repository identifies the exercised system as OpenCode and publishes its native OpenRouter configuration, system prompt, raw Harbor trial tree, normalized trial telemetry, and frozen aggregate snapshots. No immutable OpenCode package/source revision is preserved by the study, so canonical OpenCode identity is reused without asserting an exact historical revision match.

result.model_config: source model label qwen/qwen3.6-plus via OpenCode native OpenRouter provider; exact service-side checkpoint/revision not published

provenance.public_result_surface: frozen aggregate.json plus 150-row trials.jsonl and raw Harbor result tree
provenance.execution_environment: Harbor orchestration in Daytona sandboxes; same 50-task selected Terminal-Bench Pro slice; identical task Docker image per task; source-declared 40-turn budget
